stations.title: Ambrose
stations.say: Can the laptop do my bill?

stations.title: Pencil and slip
stations.text: Sums by hand, and once a negative guarantee.

captions: Ambrose prices every repair on the back of a slip, and wants the laptop to do it.
Last week the laptop printed a guarantee of a negative number of beats.
You write the sums, with the right type for each number, in five tasks.
Now the labour, the bags, the average, the beats and the parts all come out right.
Same figures as the slip. The laptop does the sums and none of them goes wrong.
